hook_say: I counted every piece at eight jewelry stores to see how much is really on sale. Two of them you can mostly skip.
sub: i counted 14,170 in-stock pieces at 8 stores

brands.stat: 98% marked down. 17% is half off or more
brands.say: heaven mayhem, up to 60% off, and 98% of the store really is marked down. the knot earrings everyone wants are 30% off, gold-plated brass, but it's all final sale so know your pick.

brands.stat: 28% of the store is half off or more
brands.say: sterling forever only says 20% off sitewide, but 28% of the store is half off or more. the sterling silver rings are where it's good, the cecilia ring is $84 from $208.

brands.stat: only 12% of the store is half off or more
brands.say: baublebar says 30% off sitewide. the deep markdowns are 12% of the store and about two thirds of those are disney, sports and holiday pieces. skip that section unless that's your thing, and look at the gold plated sterling birthstone necklaces, $46 from $138.

brands.stat: 94% marked down. 20% is half off or more
brands.say: loren hope, 30% off sitewide and that one's true, 94% of the store is marked. the big statement earrings are half off, gold finish over brass with glass stones, and most are down to the last one.

brands.stat: 31% is 40% off or more. only 4% hits 50
brands.say: jet set candy says up to 50, but only 4% of the store gets there. 31% is 40 off though, and the half-off ones are the fun charms, like the gold vermeil passport that opens, $99 from $198.

brands.stat: only 7% of the store is marked down
brands.say: ring concierge, 30% off best sellers and tennis, but that's 7% of the store. skip it unless you want 14k solid gold or lab diamonds. the easy way in is the sterling silver mini hoops, about $69.

brands.stat: 17% marked down. 5% is half off or more
brands.say: miranda frye is up to 25% off sitewide, and only 5% of the store is half off or more. so go to the cuffs: the gia cuff, 18k gold plated, is $40 from $150.

brands.stat: 34% of the store is half off or more
brands.say: and bryan anthonys, buy one get one free sitewide, plus 34% of the store is already half off or more. it's brass based, and the freshwater pearl necklace is $29 from $86. good for gifts.

close_say: So the banner and the store don't always match. Which jewelry brand should I count next?
caption: I counted how much of each jewelry store is really marked down this Black Friday, so the banner isn't the only number you get. Heaven Mayhem and Loren Hope mean it, BaubleBar and Ring Concierge are more of a maybe. Which brand should I count next? Commissionable links in bio.
pinned_comment: Counts are in-stock products on each site, read Nov 26-27. Heaven Mayhem is final sale. Most end Dec 1; Bryan Anthonys Dec 4, Loren Hope Dec 7.
